applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations (5 pads identified on Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Transformer pads identified on electrical plan (Sheet 21) and site plan (Sheet 9) lack minimum 5-foot clearance dimensions to adjacent buildings. Pad 1 and Pad 2 are located immediately adjacent to Buildings 1 and 2 respectively, but no clearance measurements are dimensioned. Pad 4 is located between Buildings 4 and 5 without documented clearances to either building.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations near fencing
findings.comment: Fence locations are not shown relative to transformer pad positions on the site plan or electrical plan, and no clearance dimensions are provided for operators/controls sides (5 feet) or non-operator sides (3 feet) from removable ventilated fences.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations where windows, doors, or ventilating ducts are present
findings.comment: No clearance dimensions from transformer pads to building windows, doors, or ventilating ducts are documented. Transformer equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified, preventing verification of 12-foot horizontal clearance requirement for oil-filled equipment when window/door/duct is less than 12 feet from grade or has less than 5 feet lateral separation.

applicableAreas: Transformer Pad 2 (west of Building 2)
findings.comment: Transformer Pad 2 is located in proximity to a sidewalk easement label on Sheet 21, but no minimum 2-foot clearance dimension from the back of sidewalk is documented.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations (5 pads)
findings.comment: Transformer pad access door orientations are not indicated on the electrical plan. Without documented access door locations, the required 10-foot clearance to open area or adjacent building/structure from the hot-stick use area cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations near fire hydrants
findings.comment: Fire hydrants are shown on the Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) but no clearance dimensions (minimum 5 feet) from transformer pads are documented. The relationship between fire hydrant locations and the five transformer pads shown on Sheet 21 is not coordinated.

applicableAreas: Trees within proposed landscape plan vicinity of transformer pads
findings.comment: Trees are identified on the landscape plan (Sheet 31) and tree list (Sheet 32), but ECM Appendix F utility compatibility designations (UC column) are not verified for trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted equipment or 15 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors.

applicableAreas: Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground transformer equipment
findings.comment: Trees positioned near transformer pad locations on the landscape plan lack documented root barrier specifications (minimum 4 feet deep, 5 feet from equipment) per landscape detail requirements.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads Pad 3, Pad 4, and Pad 5 adjacent to fire lanes
findings.comment: Transformer pads are positioned within or immediately adjacent to fire lanes (26 feet wide per Sheet 10), but no clearance documentation shows minimum 15-foot separation from fire lane boundaries.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations (5 pads identified)
findings.comment: Five transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan without minimum 5-foot clearance dimensions documented between adjacent pads. Pads 4 and 5 are in interior locations between buildings but separation distances are not specified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to water lines
findings.comment: Water service lines are routed on the Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19) but minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from transformer pads is not documented or dimensioned.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to wastewater lines
findings.comment: Wastewater service lines are routed on the Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19) but minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from transformer pads is not documented.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to storm drain infrastructure
findings.comment: Storm drain lines are shown on the site plans but minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from transformer pads is not documented.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Multiple underground utilities are shown on utility plans but minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance from transformer pads is not documented for any utility crossing or proximity condition.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations and all utility crossing areas
findings.comment: Coordination between transformer pads and utility infrastructure is not documented. No clearance verification is provided to confirm transformer pads are not located over or under utility lines, or that customer structures/foundations are not installed over Austin Energy underground facilities.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances from transformer pad locations to overhead structures, parking garage structures, enclosed areas, or to allow verification of access clearances per Austin Energy Design requirements.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Transformer equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified, and the grading plan does not document surface drainage direction around transformer pad locations. Compliance with the requirement that liquid flow must be directed away from buildings cannot be verified for oil-filled equipment.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Transformer pad location on property versus right-of-way is not clearly documented. The electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer pads but property line relationships are not dimensioned. Discrepancy exists between Sheet 21 (showing 5 pads) and Sheet 9 (showing 1 pad), creating ambiguity about actual transformer pad locations and property status.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Multiple easements are shown on the site plan (plat, Sheet 2) and utility plans, but the location of transformer pads relative to drainage easements, water easements, sewer easements, and electrical easements is not coordinated. No documentation confirms that transformer pad installation does not conflict with prohibited easements or that required Austin Energy Design written approval has been obtained.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Transformer easements are not shown on the electrical plan or plat. Easement boundaries and widths required for Austin Energy accessibility are not documented.

applicableAreas: Electrical routing from transformer pads to service meters
findings.comment: Electrical routing from transformer pads to service meters is shown on the electrical plan (Sheet 21) but documentation that the entire routing is 100% on private property (not crossing right-of-way) is not provided.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations (5 pads)
findings.comment: Transformer pad dimensions are not shown on the electrical plan. No reference is made to Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets, and the service type (single-phase or three-phase) is not specified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads located within 4 feet of parking areas
findings.comment: Transformer pads 1, 2, and 3 are located adjacent to parking and drive areas, but no 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal bollards are shown or documented on the site plan or electrical plan.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations if reduced clearances are proposed
findings.comment: Clearance measurements are not provided, so it cannot be determined whether any clearances are reduced to 3 feet. If reduced clearances are proposed, documentation of Austin Energy Design written approval and verification of required conditions (not in confined space, 10 ft+ to windows/doors/ducts, 15 ft+ vertical clearance, 3-hour fire rating) cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Stairwells serving as fire exits if present
findings.comment: No stairwells serving as fire exits are marked or identified on the building floor plans or elevations. The presence or absence of stairwells adjacent to transformer pads cannot be verified from the submitted site plan documentation.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations if oil-filled equipment is proposed and fire escapes are present
findings.comment: No fire escapes or stairs serving as fire escapes are shown on the fire protection plan (Sheet 10). Transformer equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified. Therefore, the applicability and compliance with the 20-foot horizontal/radial clearance requirement cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations if facing confined space (niche, vault, or enclosed area on 3+ sides)
findings.comment: Transformer pad access door orientations are not indicated on the electrical plan. Building configuration around transformer pads is not clearly documented in cross-sections. The presence or absence of confined space conditions (niche, vault, or enclosed area on 3+ sides) cannot be verified from the submitted documents.

applicableAreas: Shrub and vegetation locations near transformer pads
findings.comment: The landscape plan shows general planting areas but specific shrub locations relative to transformer pad access door orientations are not clearly identified. The exact position of each transformer pad (access door side versus non-access door sides) is not documented, preventing verification of 10-foot and 5-foot clearances.

applicableAreas: Bike rack locations if present near transformer pads
findings.comment: Bike racks are referenced on the project (41 spaces shown on Site Plan) but their specific locations relative to each transformer pad are not clearly documented. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified without clearer spatial coordination.

applicableAreas: Light pole locations if adjacent to transformer pads
findings.comment: No light pole locations are shown on the electrical plan or site plan relative to transformer pads. The presence and proximity of light poles to transformer equipment cannot be verified from submitted documents.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations if overhead distribution lines are present
findings.comment: Overhead distribution lines are noted via easement callouts but specific conductor locations and vertical clearance dimensions from transformer pad locations are not documented. Minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations if overhead distribution primary/neutral conductors are present
findings.comment: Overhead distribution primary and neutral conductor locations are not specifically documented on the electrical plan. The 15-foot radius clearance requirement from transformer pad locations cannot be verified without specific conductor position data.

applicableAreas: Buildings and customer facilities if located under/over overhead distribution facilities
findings.comment: Overhead distribution line routing and exact vertical clearance relationships to buildings, parking structures, and customer facilities are not clearly documented on submitted plans. Specific overhead line locations relative to building positions cannot be verified from the electrical design plan.
